claim_boundary: All four implemented baselines use the same five frozen inputs and one common finite evaluation mask per scene. No claim of superiority over an unmeasured published model.

method_definitions.coarse_dem: independent calibration DEM reprojected to the identical target grid
method_definitions.depthwizard_complete: frozen production prediction with robust affine initialization and resolution-limited low-frequency bias correction
method_definitions.raw_monocular: orientation-resolved DA3 relative output interpreted directly with no metric scale or datum fit; metric errors intentionally expose the absolute-scale gap
method_definitions.simple_affine: robust DEM-frequency-matched global scale and offset without low-frequency terrain-bias correction

published_alternatives.name: RDAH-Net
published_alternatives.reason: The released checkpoint predicts nDSM-like structural height from an RGB + Depth Anything V2 prior and has no independently datum-calibrated checkpoint for this five-scene absolute-DSM campaign. Applying reference-derived scale would violate the freeze and independence protocol.
